title: Challenges and Strategies in Cross-Cultural NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Developing a conceptual framework based on four dimensions (linguistic form, common ground, aboutness, and values) to evaluate cultural representation and surveying mitigation strategies across data collection, model training, and translation.

Analyzing existing literature on morphological, syntactic, and stylistic variations within languages to evaluate how pre-trained language models privilege certain geographical dialects, sociolects, and communicative norms.
